subject: general
question: Who among the following represents India in archery?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Deepika Kumari**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Deepika added more gold medals at the 2018 Salt Lake City World Cup.
 
• She won the individual event and added another bronze medal in Samsun.
 
• The year 2021 has been fantastic for the Indian star archer who won individual and gold team medals at the Guatemala City World Cup.

 
• Deepika Kumari defeated Germany’s Michelle Kroppen by 7-3 in the circuit final of Stage III.
 
• Deepika Kumari has won four silver medals (2011, 2012, 2013, 2015) and one Bronze in the 2018 World Cup.
 
• She has also represented India's women team in the World Championships and won two silver medals (2011, 2015).
 
• Deepika Kumari is from Jharkhand, India.​
